BiblicalUsage: Jehoshaphat prays that if judgment comes as sword or pestilence or famine, God will hear, and Ezekiel watches judgment executed on Aholibah.
TheologicalSignificance: Judgment is the sword God keeps in His own hand, and prayer is the place to stand when it comes.
